description.value: Ahous Hakuum is the Maaqutusiis Hahoulthee Stewardship Society's scheduled water taxi between Tofino's 1st Street Dock and Maaqutusiis (Ahousaht) on Flores Island — Ahousaht's own directory calls it the only water taxi with regular scheduled service to the community. Runs Monday to Friday year-round, plus Sundays in spring and summer. Resident fares are $20 each way ($10 for children/elders); non-resident fares are $50 each way. The operator has not published a bicycle policy — call ahead to confirm space and any fee before travelling with a bike.
